title: COUNTROWS ( ALL ( Sales ) ) counts every row whatever the filter context
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( ALL ( Sales ) ), 'Product'[Color] = "Blue" ) )

source.quote: In effect, ALL(Table) returns all of the values in the table, removing any filters from the context that otherwise might have been applied.
source.supports: ALL ( Sales ) as a table expression returns all rows of Sales although Product is filtered

derivation: Under Color = Blue, Sales has 2 visible rows (4, 6). ALL ( Sales ) returns all 7.
